_doc: The list of 2026-11-16's eighth phase (930): the wilds' people struck, killed and looted. folk: [who, hit points, gold min, gold max, things]; who is a whole word of a person's title ('farmhand of Oakfield', 'a weary pilgrim', 'Freed captive'), or its role; the table's order first, 'default' for the rest. Hit points and gold grow with the wilds' tier (WildGoldAt's factor). Things: Item|min|max|chance joined by ';' (each table has one sure thing, so every body leaves a pile). clips: the Dwarf pack's unarmed clips retargeted onto the townsfolk (930 clips) as their Die, Hit and Run.
